units.source_text: 古歌：“犹似堀江上，小舟来去频。

en.t: An old poem says, "As on the waters of Horie, little boats come and go again and again.

units.source_text: 追求同一女，旧梦好重温。”

en.t: Pursuing the same woman, how pleasant it is to revisit an old dream."
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 近江君引用“同一女”，是指云居雁。

en.t: When Omi no Kimi quotes "the same woman," she is referring to Kumoi no Kari.
